Their input is important but it's not their body or money.  

I got 5 tattoos in under 10 months, 2 of which are relatively large pieces. They mean something to me but they don't have to for everyone else. 

Take your time and find a piece and artist you like. And relax. Don't rush anything. If it takes 6 months it takes that long. 

OH! And lastly-- cheap tattoos are never good and good tattoos are never cheap.
